name: marekkirejczyk
description: Marek Kirejczyk's skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: marekkirejczyk-skills
plugins.description: explain-with-slides: turns a codebase or a pull request into a walkthrough deck with screenshots from the running code, UML diagrams, key files, code and diff slides, tech stack and lines of code. explain-with-video: turns the same walkthrough into a narrated MP4 with captions, chapters and a transcript. refactor-tests: brings a file, class or branch's tests up to written rules for each test type, and covers every case. self-documented-code: renames everything in a scope so each name explains itself and each concept has one name.
